plain.li: Who walks mud across here and doesn't see it?
There, that's one corner I can stop looking at.
Somebody's been eating standing up again.
[winter] Snow off the boots at the door, that's all I ask.
I'll just get this bit, then I'll sit down.

warm.li: A clean floor for them to come home to.

blunt.li: Mess again, and I know whose.

gloomy.li: It'll be dirty again by supper.

plain.li: There it comes, right where it should.
Best part of the day, and the rest of them asleep for it.
[winter] Late again this morning, the sun.
[summer] Up before me today, the sun.
Red sky this morning, so rain by evening.

warm.li: I'll have something warm going before the others wake.

gloomy.li: Another day, whether I'm ready for it or not.

cold.li: Light enough to work by soon.

plain.li: There's always one worth keeping if you look long enough.
This one's got a white stripe right through it.
[rain] They shine when they're wet, that's the trick.
Too gray, too plain, ah, now that one.
[child] This one's going in my best pile.

warm.li: I'll find one for whoever's had a bad week.

blunt.li: Found it first, so it's mine.

gloomy.li: Just rocks, really, but they're my rocks.

plain.li: Come on then, I know you're up there.
Same three as yesterday, and a new one.
[winter] Hard times for you lot in this cold.
[spring] Building nests already, are you?
Come closer, I won't bite.

warm.li: There you are, little one, I saved you a crust.

cheerful.li: The fat one's back, and he's brought a friend!

gloomy.li: At least you lot are always glad to see me.

plain.li: Let's see what's hiding in this one.
It wants to be a bird, I think.
Thin shavings, slow, that's the way.
[child] I'm making a horse, it's got three legs so far.
Mind your feet, there's shavings everywhere.

warm.li: This one's for whoever wants it when it's done.

cheerful.li: A spoon, or a duck, we'll see which!

plain.li: Hear that sound, that's a proper edge coming.
Somebody's been opening crates with this knife again.
Twenty strokes a side, no fewer.
Dull as a spoon, this one.
[lowtech] Water on the stone, and patience.

blunt.li: A dull blade is a dangerous blade.

cold.li: Same angle every stroke, that's all there is to it.

gloomy.li: It'll need doing again after the next fight.

plain.li: Deer came through there last night, see the gap?
Quiet out there, the good kind of quiet.
[winter] Fox tracks along the edge, fresh ones.
Birds are loud by the ridge, so nothing big is moving.
That trail's grown over since I last walked it.

warm.li: I like knowing what's out there.

gloomy.li: Something in there is always watching back.

plain.li: How are you feeling, {OTHER_nameDef}?
Let's have a look at that dressing.
Still warm, but better than yesterday.
You're mending faster than you think.
Drink some water, then try to sleep.

warm.li: I'll sit a while, if you'd like the company.

cheerful.li: You'll be up and about before you know it!

plain.li: Happy birthday, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Another year, {OTHER_nameDef}, and none the worse for it.
[young] Look how tall you've got this year.
[partner] Happy birthday, love.
I didn't forget, {OTHER_nameDef}, I never do.

warm.li: Happy birthday, {OTHER_nameDef}, we're lucky to have you.

blunt.li: It's your birthday, so happy birthday.

cheerful.li: Happy birthday, {OTHER_nameDef}, I've been waiting all day to say it!

plain.li: Hm hm hmm, hm hm…
Dum de dum, de dum…
Hmm hm, hmm hm, hmmm…
La la, la la la…
Da da dum, da dum…
Dee dum, dee dum, dee dee dum…
Mm hm hm, mm hm…
[winter] Hm hm, brr, hm hm…
Oh the barley's in the field and the river's running high…
Stir it slow and stir it round, the best stew's never rushed…
Onions in the pot, my love, onions in the pot…
Salt for the sorrow and pepper for the cold…
Down by the mill where the water turns the wheel…
[winter] Snow upon the roof and a fire down below…
Three good turnips and a bone, that's a supper fit for kings…
Bake it brown and bake it high, la la la…
Mm, not the blue one…
Five sacks, no, six…
Mmph, tell Fen to shut the gate…
No, the other way, the other way…
Mm, not yet, not yet…
Zzz, mm, potatoes…
Who's there, mm, oh, it's you…
Mmh, put it back where you found it…
And I'm saving that bit for last.
Don't even look at that piece, it's spoken for.
The crust first, then the good part.
[child] The soft bit's last, that's the rule.
Nearly there, and the best bit still waiting.

warm.li: Best bite last, that's how my mother did it.

cheerful.li: Here it comes, the best bite of the day!

plain.li: Measure twice, cut once.
Hang on, let me check that line again.
A finger off is a finger too many.
Square, level, and once more to be sure.
That's a hair off true, I'll redo it.
[lowtech] String's taut, peg's in, now check it again.
Now the other way round, to be certain.
I don't rush a wall, it stands longer for it.
I can take one more on top.
Two at once saves a trip.
Hup, and the other one.
My back will thank me later, or it won't.
Stack it higher, I've got it.
Heavy load coming through, mind your toes!
[winter] Warm work, this, at least.
Easy, easy, nearly there.
Quiet as anything, this time of night.
Everyone's asleep, so I can hear myself think.
[winter] Frost on everything out there already.
Just me and the night shift.
I'll sleep when this is done.
The best work gets done after midnight.
Somebody's snoring loud enough to wake the dead.
I'll finish this, then I'll think about bed.
How long do I have to lie here?
I could at least sort the seeds from here.
My legs want to go for a walk without me.
If I count the ceiling cracks again I'll scream.
Can't someone bring me something to do?
I'm fine, really, I could get up now.
Lying still is harder than a day's work.
[child] I'm bored, bored, bored.
Just one more page.
Hm, that can't be right, let me read it again.
So that's why it didn't work.
Pass the salt, would you, now where was I…
Huh. I'll have to try that.
Whoever wrote this was very sure of themselves.
[lowtech] The ink's faded here, bother.
Spoon in one hand, page in the other.
Morning. Sleep any better?
Your sister would want you eating.
I brought the stew you like.
Nobody here wants to hurt you.
Tell me about your home, if you want to.
Same time tomorrow, then.
You remembered my name, that's a start.
I know it's not much of a room, we're working on it.
In, out, and pull it snug.
That tear's not getting any bigger on my watch.
A patch here and it'll last another season.
Where did I put the thread?
Good as new. Well, good as old.
Hold still, sleeve.
[winter] Can't have a hole in a coat this time of year.
One more stitch and I'll call it done.
Just a little bird in the corner.
That's a nose, probably.
Hm, the light falls like this…
Add a hat and it's the cook to the life.
I'll draw that hill before the sun moves.
A face, a tree, another face.
Nobody look at this one, it's not finished.
Lines first. The rest follows.
Is that smoke, or just the stove?
Heard something, probably nothing.
Everyone else asleep, good.
I'll just check the fires are banked.
Quiet tonight, and I like quiet.
Can't sleep. Might as well walk round once.
[winter] Fires burning high tonight, I'll keep an eye on them.
Nose works better than my eyes in the dark.
Listen to that, you can hear it settle.
Every flake different, they say.
[child] I caught one, look, it's gone already.
[night] It glows at night, the snow does.

gloomy.li: It covers everything over, and that's a mercy.

plain.li: Just a few minutes in the sun, then back to it.
You can feel it right through to the bones.
[winter] Not much warmth in it this time of year, but I'll take it.
[child] The ground's warm here, come and sit.

cheerful.li: Now this is how a day should feel!

gloomy.li: Better make the most of it before the clouds come back.
